concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-get-grant-offers-dynamic-offers]] — 2026-09-15 pilot Capital API guide from holder-specific dynamic ranges through informational calculation to a static formal offer, with expiry, role/capability and rate limits; offer creation does not prove grant acceptance or funding.
